title: 28 Seconds Top Knot Headband Tutorial (Bullet Headband)
description:
Full explanation: https://youtu.be/5WyAeR_Ifv0

Learn how to make knot hairband and how to make top knot headband with this liverpool fabric headband bullet fabric headband tutorial. It's best to make this DIY tie knot headband or knotted turban headband with knit and stretch fabric.

Materials used in this bullet headband or tie knot headband pattern:
• Bullet poly spandex knit fabric here: https://amzn.to/3cSEPv1
• Sewing machine for beginners: https://amzn.to/3jplio5
• Stretch needles for sewing machine: https://amzn.to/30wwLuJ
• Sewing kit for beginners: https://amzn.to/30sdSJy
• Scissors for fabric cutting: https://amzn.to/3ndXCpi
• Thread cutter scissors: https://amzn.to/2GyxOTH
• Mannequin head with stand: https://amzn.to/33o070l
